passages.provision_quote: A. A person may not sell or transfer a firearm unless the person is a licensed firearms dealer, the purchaser or transferee is a licensed firearms dealer or a licensed firearms dealer facilitates the transfer pursuant to subsection B of this section.
passages.note: Prime-sponsored bill meets clause [b] (checks on every sale) but is silent on clause [a] (allow all types of firearms).
Bill status page confirms Márquez as prime sponsor; the bill was held in committee with no vote.

passages.note: Same universal-checks text sent to the voters; meets clause [b] only, silent on whether all types of firearms stay legal.

rows.reasoning: Márquez prime-sponsored HB 2621 and HCR 2034, which require that a sale or transfer go through a licensed dealer with a background check, so the clause 'require universal background checks on every sale' is evidenced. Rung 3 also requires 'allow all types of firearms', and a checks bill is silent on bans, so that clause has no evidence and the row is compound-partial.
